title: King and queen
info: The queen is the strongest piece: any number of squares, straight or diagonal, without jumping.
The king moves one square any direction. You may never move your king into check.

questions.q: You may not move your king
options: onto a square where it would be in check

questions.q: The queen combines the moves of
options: a king and a knight only
the game is over if it is checkmate

questions.q: Type the piece that moves one square any direction.
